text_block_list.text:
One morning, in the Miho Dormitory 
cafeteria...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heeey!! Turbo!! You have to eat a proper 
breakfast, you hear?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, Turbo's gonna eat pretty-colored 
donuts, so I don't care, hmph!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's a snack, not breakfast, you 
idiot! Sit your butt down here and eat a 
proper meal!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Listen! Breakfast is the most important 
meal to start the day!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
A staple, a side dish, plus some miso soup 
or soup—that's how you get all the proper 
nutrients your body needs!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I told you, I want donuts! I want the one 
with rainbow chocolate and silver 
sprinkles!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I told you to wait! Heyyy! Hold it 
right thereee!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Geez, what a hopeless kid! Well, I guess 
it's better than eating nothing at all...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I gotta go do my voluntary training quick! 
No time to be eating breakfast.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll just stick to toast today 
too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wha--!? Not you guys too!? I told you 
breakfast is important! Hey, get back 
here!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...And that's why I'm in a pinch. I just 
wanna make sure everyone at the dorm gets 
a proper breakfast!

Hishi Amazon seems to be especially 
worried about Twin Turbo.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
She keeps eating all those crazy-colored 
snacks no matter how many times I tell her 
not to!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And maybe because it's a hassle, she 
doesn't even want to eat meals where the 
rice and side dishes are served 
separately!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm just worried that she might collapse 
during training one of these days...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Lately, more and more folks have been 
following Turbo's lead and skipping out on 
breakfast."

Hishi Amazon's concerns are completely 
justified. In that case...
choice_data_list:
How about making dishes that look really 
eye-catching?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
So you want it to look like something 
Turbo would like? Still, we have to 
consider nutrition, you know.
choice_data_list:
How about a uniquely shaped rice ball 
that's quick to eat?

Which one is the powerfully colorful 
sandwich?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Rice balls... That's it! If I pack the 
side dishes right inside as fillings, I 
can eat them too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If we make it into a fun, unusual shape, 
maybe Turbo will get interested and 
actually eat it!
choice_data_list:
It's just an application of character 
bento.

It's just an application of character 
bento!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Turbo just refuses to eat stuff 
before trying it. As long as she likes how 
it looks, she'll be fine!"

The next morning, in the Miho Dormitory 
kitchen...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Seasoned rice here, meat rolls here... Add 
some nori and the little bear is finished!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Wow, you're making something so neat! It 
looks deliciousー!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, welcome! Eat as much as you want, 
go on!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yay! Make this every day, Hishi Ama!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, leave it to me! I'll make all sorts 
of goodies!

These generously filled, uniquely shaped 
rice balls apparently became a hit among 
the Miho Dorm residents.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I see! That way, we get plenty of 
nutrition, and it'll look nice and 
colorful too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Turbo loves flashy-colored food, so if I 
make it look irresistible to eat...!
choice_data_list:
You're good at making character bentos, 
huh.

You're so good at making character bentos, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's making breakfast, so it's a 
piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
A clubhouse sandwich packed with meat and 
veggies, and over here is a fresh fruit 
sandwich!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Wow, you're making something so pretty! It 
looks deliciousー!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I woke up early and put my whole 
heart into making this for you!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Really!? Yay!! Let's call it the "Special 
Turbo Sandwich"!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, mission accomplished! You gotta eat 
well every single day from now on, okay?

The colorful, hearty sandwiches seem to 
have become a hit among the Miho Dorm 
students.
